answer: We formalize a decentralized network where validators stake dynamic opportunity-cost bonds intersecting a cryptographic ridge of zero-knowledge verifiable delays to deter identity fragmentation. When an attacker attempts Sybil multiplication, subgame-perfect punishment matrices enforce catastrophic slashing penalties that propagate through the system like a swift zephyr, stripping all collateral. Consequently, the expected payoff of splitting computational stake along any parallel vine drops strictly below zero, proving that honest resource consolidation forms a robust Nash equilibrium.
